title: What to Negotiate in a Job Offer: Understanding Benefits & Compensation
description:
In this class, we're going to talk about understanding compensation and how to negotiate for what ultimately matters to you. Compensation is a very broad topic—and it's not just about your cash compensation. We want to make you aware of all the dimensions of the things you can look out for, what’s more likely to be negotiable, and then ultimately how you can go about negotiating.

That looks like: 

00:00 | Introduction
01:00 | Our approach and how we think about compensation
07:34 | Total compensation (i.e., EVERYTHING the company is providing you in exchange for your work)
21:15 | How to research what fair market value is for your role
30:49 | How to prepare for the negotiation
35:19 | The negotiation itself & how to maximize your value
46:29 | Wrapping up & conclusion

Here’s a link to our checklist, which shows the various elements that MAY make up a total rewards package: https://tealhq.co/totalrewards. NOTE: Not all of these things are negotiable, but they’re worth being aware of. You can’t ask for what we don’t know what to ask for. 

For more on compensation and negotiation, visit www.tealhq.com.
